The '''snow screen''' was part of an [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[Stormtrooper/Legends|stormtrooper's]] cold weather kit. It fitted over the standard issue helmet and served as a breather hood to warm the air before it fed into the [[Stormtrooper armor/Legends|suit's]] liner and reached the user's [[Lung/Legends|lungs]].
